title: General return window
content: Most items are returnable within 30 days of delivery when they are in sellable condition and include all accessories. Shipping fees are not refundable.

title: Electronics returns
content: Electronics have a 30-day return window. Opened electronics must include all accessories and are subject to a 10% restocking fee.

title: Restocking fees by category
content: Restocking fees depend on the item category and condition. Sealed items have no restocking fee; opened-item rates are listed in the category-specific policies.

title: Opened electronics restocking fee
content: Opened electronics returned within the valid window have a 10% restocking fee. Sealed electronics have no restocking fee.

title: Apparel restocking fee
content: Apparel with tags removed or light wear may be accepted within 30 days with a 5% restocking fee. New-with-tags apparel has no fee.

title: Home and kitchen restocking fee
content: Opened home and kitchen items in good condition may have a 5% restocking fee when returned within 30 days. Sealed items have no fee.

title: Books and physical media returns
content: Books and unopened physical media may be returned within 30 days. Opened books have no restocking fee; opened digital media is not covered by this demonstration policy.

title: Refurbished item returns
content: Refurbished items have a 14-day return window. Opened refurbished items have a 15% restocking fee.

title: Shipping fee refunds
content: Original and expedited shipping fees are not refundable unless the return is caused by a fulfillment error or a verified damaged-on-arrival case.

title: Damaged or defective on arrival
content: Items damaged in transit or defective on arrival qualify for a replacement or full merchandise refund when reported within seven days of delivery.
